messages:
maya: Heads-up — we've had a couple reports of leads being sent to 'no-owner' during peak bursts. Looks like the RR assigner sometimes skips when enrichment lag spikes. Noticed +2% unclaimed on Friday.

devon: ugh. any quick mitigation?

maya: plan proposal: enforce a 30s handshake SLA after enrichment step. If enrichment not done, fallback to 'sdr-overflow' pool. Also add a heartbeat so we don't double-assign.

samir: can we surface which rule skipped? iirc some hubspot workflows are async so ordering gets weird.

maya: yes — root cause is enrichment webhook to /lead-enrich returns 202 then callback to /assign, sometimes callback delayed >45s. In that window rr assumes missing and marks owner null.

leah: adding to that — SF connector retries are throttled which makes the issue worse for enterprise webhooks.

devon: short-term patch: make assign idempotent and add `claim_timeout_seconds=30`. If assign not confirmed, auto-requeue with jitter.

samir: can you drop the config snippet you mean?

maya: sure — putting a tiny snippet here for ops:

```
# routing config
round_robin:
  claim_timeout_seconds: 30
  retry_jitter_ms: 2500
  fallback_pool: "sdr-overflow"
  max_retries: 3
```

leah: nice. also recommend adding a HubSpot workflow gate: only call /assign after enrichment webhook status == `complete`. That avoids race from the HS side.

devon: agree. we'll add a HubSpot property `enrichment_status` and gate. can someone own the HS change?

maya: volunteering to PR the HS workflow change. I'll also add a quick canary: route 5% of leads through new gate.

samir: for observability — expose metrics: `lead.assign.attempts`, `lead.assign.success`, `lead.assign.unclaimed_count`, and `lead.enrich.latency_p95`. Then dashboard and alert if unclaimed_count > 1% in 15m.

leah: ops-bot — create a jira for the long-term playbook and link runbook.

ops-bot: Created TASK-4281: "Lead routing: handoff SLA + enrichment gate" assigned to deveng. Link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/TASK-4281 :white_check_mark:

devon: rollout checklist suggestion:
- prod feature flag on (5% canary)
- monitor metrics for 30m
- increase to 25% if stable
- full roll after 24h stable

maya: one more constraint: sales wants <2% contested claims (where two reps think they own). For the gate we'll add a claim_ttl of 12h and a takeover policy. If takeover after 12h, new owner gets a forced notify.

samir: question re SF — will takeover flow surface as matched owner field in SF so CSMs see it?

leah: yes, will add `owner_history` property on contact, append events with timestamps so handoffs are auditable.

maya: i'll patch our playbook doc with the exact HS rule and the dd metrics. will ping here when PRs are up.

devon: thanks — if you want i can fast-follow with a quick rollback plan (revert gate + set fallback pool to existing behavior).

maya: please. also let's add an email to sales ops with the canary start time.

leah: sample SalesOps message: "Canary start: Tue 09:00 PT. Routing gate enabled for 5% of inbound leads. Expect short-lived increases in enqueue delays <1min. Contact ops@redwood.ai for issues."

samir: adding one more test case for QA: simulate enrichment callback delay of 60s and verify fallback picks sdr-overflow and lead is not left unassigned.

maya: perfect. will follow up with links to PR + HS workflow change. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder set for Tue 08:50 PT to post SalesOps canary message.
